session_rule: Use one openIntentId, one open_from_chat call, and the returned viewerSessionId for every later operation.

steps.request: Resolve inputs/4AKE.pdb to its exact absolute path and open it once with a new UUID openIntentId.
Read the current sceneRevision, primary object ID, load status, and capability manifest.
steps.precondition: viewerReady is true and load.status is ready

request.path: resolve inputs/1AKE.pdb to its exact absolute path

steps.request: Confirm the primary object and adk_ap5_bound_1ake, their visibility, frame counts, source names, and transforms.

At the current expectedRevision, apply each scene from outputs/storyboard-model.json. Use canonical cartoon and sticks layers; preserve the exact object matrices. Run dryRun before the first mutation.
Save each applied scene under its exact retained name and record every appliedRevision.
Verify the four named scenes and capture their source revisions.
Restore each scene in order. After every restore, call get_state and compare objects, visibility, transforms, camera, layers, selection, and focus with outputs/storyboard-model.json.
Save the current open state once as zz-disposable-restore-test.
Delete only zz-disposable-restore-test at the current expectedRevision, then call get_state and verify that the live molecular state did not change.
After all restore evidence is retained, remove only adk_ap5_bound_1ake and confirm that the primary 4AKE object remains.

completion_evidence_required: scene list and per-scene restore comparisons
claims_currently_supported: The local scene model and matrices exist.
Two local state mutations were restored exactly in the retained JSON model.
claims_awaiting_viewer_execution: Native scenes were saved or restored.
A disposable native scene was deleted.
The secondary viewer object was removed.
Any viewer image or movie was rendered.
